behaviors.behavior: Perform inference on the DNN model using train/test dataset and collect the resulting input and output tensors of the operator to construct calibration data.
behaviors.precondition: Quantization propagation rule is applied to node N; train/test dataset available.

evidence.quote: we first perform inference on the corresponding DNN model using train/test dataset, and collect the resulting input and output tensors of that operator to construct calibration data (line 20)

behaviors.behavior: Gradually reduce the quantization precision (e.g., 32-bit to 16-bit) of one tensor of the operator while keeping other tensors unchanged.
behaviors.precondition: Calibration data has been collected for the operator.

evidence.quote: we gradually reduce the quantization precision (e.g., 32-bit to 16-bit) of one tensor of this operator while keeping other tensors unchanged

behaviors.behavior: Quantize and fine-tune the operator using the calibration data under the new precision.
behaviors.precondition: A tensor's precision has been lowered; calibration data available.

evidence.quote: The operator is then quantized and fine-tuned using the calibration data under the new precision.

behaviors.behavior: Fine-tune to minimize the Mean Squared Error between the output tensors in the calibration data and the output tensors of the operator after lowering the precision.
behaviors.precondition: The operator is being fine-tuned under the lowered precision.

evidence.quote: The fine-tuning is to minimize Mean Squared Error (MSE) between the output tensors in calibration data and the output tensors of that operator after lowering the precision.

behaviors.behavior: Accept the new quantization attribute of the operator if the drop of model accuracy is smaller than a predefined threshold (e.g., 1% in the experiment).
behaviors.precondition: Fine-tuning under the new precision has been performed; accuracy drop measured against threshold.

evidence.quote: If the drop of model accuracy is smaller than a predefined threshold (e.g., 1% in our experiment), the new quantization attribute of that operator is accepted (line 22).

behaviors.behavior: Repeat the precision-lowering and evaluation process for other tensors in the operator until all tensors are evaluated.
behaviors.precondition: At least one tensor of the operator has been evaluated.

evidence.quote: The process repeats for other tensors in the operator, until all tensors are evaluated.

behaviors.behavior: Work through all operators in the DNN model in topological order and cache the activations computed in earlier quantization propagations.

evidence.quote: SparTA works through all the operators in a DNN model in a topological order and caches the activations computed in earlier quantization propagations.

behaviors.behavior: Collect an operator's calibration data via partial inference from the nearest cached activations to that operator.
behaviors.precondition: Cached activations from an earlier (topologically preceding) operator exist.

evidence.quote: Collecting an operator’s calibration data only needs partial inference from the nearest cached activations to this operator.

behaviors.behavior: Initialize Supdated to the empty set and set S to the union of the node's input TeSAs Is and output TeSAs Os.
behaviors.precondition: QuantizationPropRule is invoked on node N with inputs Is and outputs Os.

behaviors.behavior: If Tupdated differs from T, update S with Tupdated and add Tupdated to Supdated.
behaviors.precondition: Tupdated has been computed and Tupdated != T.

evidence.quote: if Tupdated != T then S.Update(Tupdated ); Supdated .Update(Tupdated );

behaviors.behavior: If Tupdated equals T, skip updating S and Supdated for that tensor.
behaviors.precondition: Tupdated has been computed and Tupdated == T.

behaviors.behavior: Return the accumulated updated TeSAs split into separate input and output TeSAs via SplitToIsOs(Supdated).
behaviors.precondition: All tensors in (Is∪Os) have been evaluated.

behaviors.behavior: Register QuantizationPropRule as a propagation rule via RegisterPropRule(QuantizationPropRule).
behaviors.precondition: Propagation rules are being registered before PropOneNode execution.

behaviors.behavior: For a sequential model with layers La then Lb, after propagation on La caches its output activations, collect Lb's calibration data by partial inference from La's collected output activations.
behaviors.precondition: The model is sequential with two layers La and Lb, and propagation on La has already collected its output activations.

evidence.quote: consider a sequential model with two layers La and Lb. The propagation on La has collected its output activations in its calibration data. When working on Lb, its calibration data can be collected by doing partial inference from the collected output activations of La.
